subject: SAML assertion samples + SCIM delta for SIG response — ownership & timeline
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah.park@urbancare.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: sec-ops@urbancare.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: SIG - sample SAML assertions and SCIM delta for control A.4

Hi Jonas,

As part of our SIG assessment (control family: Access Control / Provisioning), the security team is asking for: 1) representative SAML assertion samples for interactive and federated logins (include NameID, attributes, and timestamps), and 2) a sample SCIM delta with a recent user create/update/delete that shows attribute mappings and external IDs.

Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted examples and who on your side will own the drop? We need artifacts uploaded to the shared Drive by EOD Thursday so we can finish our evidence pack for the audit next week.

Thanks,
Leah Park
Director, Compliance — UrbanCare
(leah.park@urbancare.com)

[Internal note: pointing sec-ops at this thread for any technical clarifications.]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG - sample SAML assertions and SCIM delta for control A.4

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear ask. We'll take ownership. Quick plan below: 

- Laura will curate a small set (3) of redacted SAML assertions illustrating: interactive SSO, service-to-service assertion (machine-to-machine with delegated user), and an expired/clock-skew sample.
- Ben will extract a SCIM delta showing one create, one update (role attribute change), and one delete. He'll include externalId mapping and the attribute-to-role mapping snippet.
- I'll upload everything to the shared Drive link you provided and add a short README that maps each artifact to the SIG control identifiers.

Question for you: do you need raw SAML XML, or would CSV with parsed attributes be preferable for ingestion into your evidence tracker?

Target: upload by 2026-09-23 23:59 PT (EOD Thursday PDT). If you need earlier, say so and we'll prioritize.

Jonas Weber

Subject: Re: SIG - sample SAML assertions and SCIM delta for control A.4

Jonas / Leah — creating the artifacts now. A few notes: 

- Deliverable format: providing both raw SAML XML (redacted) and a companion CSV that parses the assertion attributes (NameID, email, groups, role) — that should make it easy for your tracker to ingest.
- SCIM: Ben and I generated a delta export (scim_delta_example.json) with three ops: POST (create user), PATCH (update roles -> roles array), DELETE (remove user). We intentionally include externalId mapping and the enterpriseUser:manager attribute to show hierarchical mapping.
- Redaction: replaced real emails with example domains and removed UUIDs for userIds; timestamps retained to show freshness.

Attachments (to be uploaded to Drive and linked here):
- saml_assertion_samples.csv (parsed attributes + pointer to raw XML files)
- saml_assertion_interactive.xml (redacted)
- saml_assertion_service.xml (redacted)
- saml_assertion_expired.xml (redacted)
- scim_delta_example.json

I will upload to the Drive folder and drop the link in this thread by 12:30 PT.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: (attachment: saml_assertion_samples.csv, text/csv), (attachment: scim_delta_example.json, application/json)

Subject: Re: SIG - sample SAML assertions and SCIM delta for control A.4

Adding the role mapping export and service-account inventory per the audit checklist. A couple of clarifications for UrbanCare intake team: 

1) Role mapping - attached as role_mapping_export.csv. Columns: role_id, role_name, mapped_group, min_privilege_description. This demonstrates our RBAC prune and least-privilege mapping.
2) Service accounts - included service_account_inventory.csv showing owner, use-case, allowed-scopes, and whether the account is subject to JIT or long-lived keys.

Note: The SCIM delta includes a PATCH operation that updates the "roles" attribute; we also include an explanatory snippet in the README about how roles map to permissions in the runtime.

Ben Carter
Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: (attachment: role_mapping_export.csv, text/csv), (attachment: service_account_inventory.csv, text/csv)

Thanks team — this looks good. A couple quick clarifying asks before we finalize the SIG entry: 

- Can you include one SAML sample that shows the "authnContextClassRef" value you set for MFA sessions? We need to see the difference between authN flows.
- For the SCIM delta, can you add the SCIM schema URN used for the "roles" attribute in the PATCH example? That helps our parser match attributes to control IDs.

If you can add those two small items by EOD Thursday we'll be in good shape. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— UrbanCare SecOps
